card.summary: Kiro Free: USD 0 per month, 50 credits a month, access to open weight models and Claude Sonnet 4.5 'with limits'; add-on credits are not available on Free

record.tooling: Kiro IDE and Kiro CLI; Kiro Web is available to paid plans only
record.chaining: the Free tier is the same account and the same model set as Pro, so a measurement taken today stays valid if the account is later upgraded

limits.value: 50 credits a month on Free; 1,000 on Pro at USD 20; 2,000 on Pro+ at USD 40; 5,000 on Pro Max at USD 100; 10,000 on Power at USD 200

free_tier.stated: Kiro Free: USD 0 per month, 50 credits a month, access to open weight models and Claude Sonnet 4.5 'with limits'; add-on credits are not available on Free
free_tier.notes: a credit is the metering unit; the pricing page says usage limits reset at the start of each billing month with no rollover. The unit is credits, not requests (open question)

record.interface_detail: the Kiro IDE; sign-in is by social login or an AWS Builder ID

identity_cost.detail: social login or an AWS Builder ID for the IDE sign-in; paid plans need a valid credit card. Enterprise and AWS GovCloud have no Free tier

record.confidence_note: the ladder is quoted from the vendor page read. The credit-to-token conversion is unpublished, so capacity in tokens is unverified.

evidence.proved: Free USD 0 with 50 credits; Pro USD 20 with 1,000; Pro+ USD 40 with 2,000; Pro Max USD 100 with 5,000; Power USD 200 with 10,000; add-on credits USD 0.04 each
the Free tier has 50 credits and includes open weight models and Claude Sonnet 4.5 with limits
evidence.quote: New users can start with the perpetual Kiro Free tier, which includes 50 credits. The Free Tier includes access to open weight models and Claude Sonnet 4.5, with limits.

evidence.proved: the allowance window is a billing month with no rollover
evidence.quote: Usage limits reset at the start of each billing month. Unused credits do not roll over to the next month.

evidence.proved: a card is needed only to upgrade to a paid plan
evidence.quote: Upgrading to a paid subscription requires a valid credit card.

evidence.proved: subscriptions work with the IDE, CLI, Web, Crew and ACP compatible IDEs
evidence.quote: Kiro subscriptions can be used with Kiro IDE, Kiro CLI, Kiro Web, Kiro Crew, ACP compatible IDEs, and automation in software development

evidence.proved: Free still includes Claude Sonnet 4.5 and open weight models, with limits
evidence.quote: The Free Tier includes access to open weight models and Claude Sonnet 4.5, with limits.

evidence.proved: the credit ladder 50, 1,000, 2,000, 5,000 and 10,000 is unchanged
the perpetual Free tier still has 50 credits
evidence.quote: New users can start with the perpetual Kiro Free tier, which includes 50 credits.

record.notes: 50 credits a month against 1,000 on a USD 20 plan is 5 per cent of the paid allowance, which is the smallest free-to-paid ratio in the class.
